sections.title: Part 2 · Reading — Mai's directions
sections.sub: Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi.
sections.passage:
Hi Lan,

Welcome to my neighbourhood! Here is the best way to get to my house from the bus stop. It's within walking distance. It takes about ten minutes.

The bus stop is across from the City Museum. It's a famous landmark, so you can't miss it. First, walk along Green Street for two blocks until you get to a busy intersection. There is a pharmacy on the corner.

After that, turn right and go past the library and a small café. Don't cross the road! Finally, my house is on your left, between the bookshop and the bank. It's the blue house. The main entrance is at the side of the house.

See you on Saturday!
Mai

sections.title: Part 3 · Listening — Anna's phone call
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: Anna is at the ____.
How long does it take to walk?
First, go out of the main entrance and turn ___.
Walk two ____ until you get to a busy intersection.
What is on the corner?
After that, Anna goes past…
Ben's building is across from the ___.
What landmark is next to his building?

script: Hi Ben, it's Anna. I'm at the train station. What's the best way to get to your apartment?
Hi Anna! It's within walking distance. It takes about fifteen minutes.
Great. How do I get there?
First, go out of the main entrance and turn left.
Then walk two blocks until you get to a busy intersection. There's a big bank on the corner.
A bank on the corner. Got it.
After that, turn right and go past the supermarket and the park.
Go past the supermarket and the park.
Finally, my building is on your left. It's across from the post office.
Across from the post office. Is there a landmark near it?
Yes. There's a famous old cinema next to my building. You can't miss it.
Perfect. See you in fifteen minutes!

sections.title: Part 4 · Speaking — Shadowing
sections.sub: Nghe mẫu → đọc theo → ghi âm. Máy chấm điểm trên thang 10 và tô màu từng từ.

items.prompt: Give directions from the hotel to the station

sentences.text: The station is within walking distance. It takes about ten minutes.
First, go out of the hotel and turn left.
Then walk two blocks until you get to a busy intersection.
After that, go past the bank, then turn right.
Finally, the station is on the corner, across from a famous landmark.
The main entrance is on River Road.
